english: [ctrl:FFA3]Yes, suspicious.\nEspecially the nose...\nJust a feeling, though.
[ctrl:FFA3]Right. This one's\nsuspicious in a more\nobvious way.
[ctrl:FFA3]Go on, then.\nCheck your nose\nin the bathroom.
[ctrl:FFA2]What are you on about?!\nNo business? I'm going!
[ctrl:FFA3]Suspicious, yes...\n[ctrl:FFA2]But not the kind\nwe're looking for.
[ctrl:FFA2]Come on, Gin. No time\nfor someone with\na suspicious nose!
[ctrl:FFA3]Kagura, restrain Shinpachi.\n...So, what are you\ndoing here tonight?
[ctrl:FFA3]Who with? Not just\nmother and daughter\ndining here, surely?
[ctrl:FFA2]So it WAS the nose\nthat was suspicious.
[ctrl:FFA2]I said ONLY my nose\nhad plastic surgery!
[ctrl:FFA2]Barging in like that!\nWhat do you want?\nEating, obviously!
[ctrl:FFA3]Popularity's your business.\nHave to keep\nyour connections alive.
[ctrl:FFA2]How rude! I'd never\ndo such a thing!
[ctrl:FFA2]Oh? Aren't you...\n[ctrl:FFB1]Otsu Fan Club Captain,\ncome to Santa Monica...!
[ctrl:FFA2]Otsu?! What's wrong?!\nRonin Tama deals,\nrebels and Katsura?!
[ctrl:FFA3]Surely not...\nDoing this and that\nwith dirty old men...?!
[ctrl:FFA3]Come to think of it...\nOdd. She was just with me.
[ctrl:FFA3]Right. Is Katsura...\nI mean, Zurako\nnot here tonight?
[ctrl:FFA3]What? Some impudent\ndrag queen snubbed me?\nMama, make her [ctrl:FFA5]slit her belly.
[ctrl:FFA3]You lot again?\nStop getting\nin the way of work!
[ctrl:FFA3]Why would I lie?\nShe insisted on\nworking tonight's party...
[ctrl:FFA2]No doubt now!\nThe rebels' shady\nGin Tama deal is here!
ARGH! Get changed!\nTake off the makeup!
Shut up! Get in the way\nand you're arrested too!
[ctrl:FFA3]That rebel Gin Tama deal?\nThe Idiot Prince\nmasterminded it.
[ctrl:FFA3]Idiot Prince set it up.\nThe rebels were dupes.\nRight, Shinpachi?
[ctrl:FFA3]So arrest him,\nmake him confess,\nor cut him down. Your choice.
[ctrl:FFA3]Doubt me? Wasting\na good citizen's\nkindness, are we?
[ctrl:FFA2]Me?![ctrl:FFB1] So I WAS\nthe gift you brought!
[ctrl:FFA2]Kondo, cash and Gin Tama\nin the Idiot Prince's bags!\nSeems he told the truth.
[ctrl:FFA2]Y-yes! Selling Gin Tama\nat outrageous prices\nto buy a space cicada!
Not a grain of rice left.\nWe'll really starve\nat this rate...

That's a line for people
who've actually HAD money
come their way! Find a job! Now!
Or I'll throw you out
for real!
Still have the nerve\nto say that?!!
More like thrown out\nof our NEW home...

Then what?
No space pirates
this time, either... Oh! The Shinsengumi!
Banning Tama inquiries?
Suspicious, aren't they?
[ctrl:FFA3]A promise between men.\nTalk to the manager.
[ctrl:FFA1]Damn! [ctrl:FFA3]Fine.\nI'll talk to him.[ctrl:FFB1] But!\nDon't you disgrace me!
[ctrl:FFA2]Relax. Not much\nof a face to lose.
[ctrl:FFA3]Ugh, fine. A loss\nis a loss. I admit it.\nI'll work here as promised!
[ctrl:FFA3]A promise between men.\nI hate it, but\nwe have to honor it.
[ctrl:FFA3]Don't think, Mr. Hasegawa.\nThink and you lose!
[ctrl:FFA3]Say we're chefs\ntrained at a famous\nKyoto place. Whatever.
[ctrl:FFA3]What?! Even I\nhaven't set foot\nin the kitchen!
[ctrl:FFA2]Wait! Don't be rash![ctrl:FFB1]\nListen! This is a game!
Gin Tama will beat you!\nBrace yourself, robot!
Fine. A promise\nis a promise. Do as you like.\n...Let's go, Shinpachi, Kagura.
I win. As promised,\nno more prying.
Next time, buy me\nmatcha cream zenzai.
Advice? What?\nNot 'cut back on sweets.'\nThey're my reason to live.
Hm? Oh, damn.\nI DID tell them\nrebels gather here...

Trying to let old Hiraga
escape. Slipped out... That bastard tricked me!
Said investigating
Gin Tama was forbidden!
A rare cicada creature\nfrom Alpha was online.\nI simply had to have it.
Tch! Don't care!\nOverthinking makes you bald.\nBald AND glasses? No girls!
Because you can't\npark illegally\nwherever you like... Right?
Kondo's responsible.\nMaybe...\fHe means to investigate\nGin Tama alone.
No one's committing seppuku!\fDirty work's for me,\nthe Vice-Chief.
All that racket swinging...\nDoesn't he get tired?
Take out trash\non the proper day.
Ah, Shinsengumi!\nWhat can I do for you?
I'll kill you! How rude!\fOh, I get it!\nA new pickup line!!

I understand
why you'd try... I'm beautiful.
Clever and charming. Of course men
can't leave me alone.
That gorilla\nbought lots of dango.\fWhat's with him?\nQuite a lavish gorilla.
Which way did\nMr. Lavish Gorilla go?
Hm? Old man,\nhave we met before?
Can we just leave\nthis old man here?

Game over without
me, the hero, appearing?
Impossible! Gin fans nationwide
would be in tears.
Using the chaos\nto kill me, huh.
Toshi! This is\nthe moment to prove\nmy love!
No one blocks my love!\nNot even you, Toshi!
A peaceful life\nwithout a persistent\nstalker following me.
A local police case.\nShinsengumi weren't called.
